critical_code_review_comments: No tombstones for deletions: hydrateCombos() pushes the whole local list up on every bootstrap/login (comboApi.sync(getCombos())). If a combo is deleted on device A, device B (which still holds it in localStorage and has not reloaded) will RE-CREATE it on the account at its next bootstrap. Verified logically, not a blocker for the tested single-device flow, but consider a deleted_ids list or letting the server be authoritative (use comboApi.list() when local is empty / add updated_at + tombstones).

combos.js saveCombo/deleteCombo fire-and-forget the network call and swallow ALL errors (.catch(() => {})). A 5xx/network failure for a LOGGED-IN user is indistinguishable from the guest 401 case: the user believes the combo is synced. Suggest distinguishing 401 (guest, silent) from other errors (toast/warning).

Guest UI cannot actually create a combo because the planner recipe picker renders 0 categories for anonymous users (recipe visibility gating). The 'guest fallback' path therefore only matters for a user who saved while logged in and later lost the session — worth noting in the spec rather than fixing.
Backend caps sync at payload.combos[:50] silently while the client caps local at 20 — extra combos beyond 50 are dropped without any signal; acceptable but undocumented.
